profile.migration_strategy_justification: Create task bindings only after universal worktree lanes exist, then backfill exclusively from complete persisted epic_task_files budgets. Dormant pre-execution legacy plans with no budgets remain unbound and activation-blocked; partial budgets or any execution authority still refuse migration.

invariants: Every binding references an existing item-owned path claim and an existing generated Epic task.
Task bindings carry no registering-session or work-claim authority and survive session handoff.
workflow_item_worktree_records applies first and every migrated task has valid worker-lane ownership.
Legacy bindings derive only from complete persisted epic_task_files budgets; dormant pre-execution plans with wholly empty budgets remain unbound and activation-blocked.
Partial budgets, live execution authority, cross-project targets, and unmapped claims refuse migration.
Repeat apply preserves existing rows; every nonterminal required-per-task item either has no generated tasks, is a safely deferred dormant all-empty plan, or passes complete task coverage.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration is additive and idempotent. Dormant legacy plans with wholly empty epic_task_files are not assigned invented task ownership: they stay unbound and the existing activation gate blocks execution until planning persists budgets and explicit bindings. Partial legacy budgets and any active claim or work authority still hard-refuse.
